email.subject1: a signal play for Placer.ai partners
email.body1:
Fryderyk, saw Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR and is expanding new products and data partnerships.

A partner ecosystem at that scale usually surfaces more co-sell accounts than the team can cover before anyone can act on them, and partner-sourced pipeline coverage slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play across Placer.ai's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Fryderyk, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

As new data partnerships come online, co-sell opportunities usually outpace the team's ability to act on them, and partner-sourced pipeline stays under-covered. Most teams cannot say how much they are leaving on the table.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how much partner-sourced pipeline Placer.ai could cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Fryderyk, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body4:
Fryderyk, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and standing up new data partnerships keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to Placer.ai's partner motion? I will tailor it either way.
